top_signals.title: Defiance ETF Looks to Make Impact Against Autism
top_signals.summary:
Matthew Bielski, founder and CEO at Defiance ETFs, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "ETF IQ". They discuss the Defiance Autism Impact ETF (ticker: ASD) and Bielski's personal family story tied to autism.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Opportunities in Yields, Thematic Investing, Sports ETFs on the Horizon
top_signals.summary: "Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: Global X CEO Ryan O'Connor, Futuresports Head of Index Services Jodie Gunzberg, Defiance ETFs CEO & Founder Matthew Bielski, and BondBLOXX COO & Co-Founder Joanna Gallegos.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
